note: v2474: 135. The grail chronicle counts the games 403 Chronicle ROWS while the wall offers 398 NAMES, so done tops out below total and complete never becomes true for grail. The rotations grail arm only assigned a pick inside if(it), and once the wall is exhausted there is no runs[0] and no missing[0], so no pick was written and dailyCreateAi fell past both of its arms to removeItem. The Daily Pick was wiped, and because the same state recurs every day it never came back. Measured through the real page over three states: 0 of 403 gives a pick, 398 of 403 gave none and was WIPED, 403 of 403 is unreachable by the arithmetic. It now names the state instead of disappearing, and deliberately does not explain the gap - chronicle_total.py records 403 rows against 396 distinct names and a 398 roster, and calls that difference unaccounted, so the sentence says how big it is and that nobody has explained it rather than inventing a reason.
